response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with a strong general software background, but the profile is fundamentally misaligned with this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, minimal recent C work (a brief C/C++ stint in 2014-2015), and no experience with LAN switches, MACsec, 802.1X, or embedded firmware development. His career trajectory centers on web platforms, TypeScript/Node.js, and DLang services rather than embedded security features.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience, well above the 3-year minimum
Some systems-level exposure (low-latency DLang services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux familiarity)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement for this role
No embedded networking, switch, kernel-modification, or firmware experience; no C/UNIX proficiency in the last decade
No exposure to required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, tamper detection) or networking protocols (NETCONF, SNMP)
